document.title: Form PENS.S/3 — Signature Specimen of Child Aged 16 Years or Older

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/3 — Signature Specimen of Child Aged 16 Years or Older
chunks.heading: What form PENS.S/3 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.S/3 is completed by a child aged 16 years or older whose benefit is being paid directly into his or her own bank account, to register the child's signature with UNJSPF.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/3 — Signature Specimen of Child Aged 16 Years or Older
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.S/3
chunks.text: Section 1 - Retiree or beneficiary information (UID, pension number, retirement number, name); Section 2 - Child information (UID, date of birth, name, address, contact details); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature specimen; Section 4 - Signature authentication.

chunks.part: Form PENS.S/3 — Signature Specimen of Child Aged 16 Years or Older
chunks.heading: When and how a child's benefit is paid directly to the child under form PENS.S/3
chunks.text: At the request of a retiree or beneficiary, or under specific exceptional circumstances, a child's benefit may be paid directly to a child aged 16 years or older who is able to open a bank account. The child must sign the form in the presence of a United Nations official, government official or notary public, and the signature is retained on file for verification; a new form must be submitted if the signature changes.
